page.overview:
Who is Katana Brothers?

The Katana Brothers, are characters from the Final Fight series, only appearing in Mighty Final Fight as the palette swap brothers of Sodom and the game's sole new boss characters.

Masamune's colors are the reverse of Sodom's, sporting a red mask and pants plus blue armor. Murasame wears a gray mask and pants plus black armor.

Sodom is the boss of stage 2 while the first brother, Masamune, is the boss of stage 4 and the second, Murasame, is a sub-boss during the final stage, fighting alongside Abigail. All three brothers play identically.
